title: Measure how the scorer handles citations and design an XML-artifact citation check (#831)
body:
## Goal
Measure, then design. The XML key-agreement scope for both library inventories is closed (review #882 CLEAR at abd491f9). The next open method gap is the #831 design limit: `benchmark/scripts/score.py` never checks a submitted answer's citation (locator) against the original XML artifact, so grounding (evaluation.md EV:78, separate fidelity / correctness / grounding) is not measured. Report, do not fix: do not edit `score.py`, `check_xml_keys.py`, fixtures, keys or pin maps.
Write one new file, `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md`, with:
1. what score.py does today with citation/locator/source fields of a submitted answer (function names and line numbers you read);
2. whether `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` locator resolution could be reused for submitted answers (function names and line numbers);
3. a design for a citation check: input shape, pass/fail rule (cited locator resolves in the artifact whose sha256 matches the fixture, and the text there equals the answered literal), where it plugs in, and which live pin maps would need re-pinning if implemented;
4. at least three controls with expected outcomes written before any implementation: a correct citation (pass), a wrong locator (fail), a right locator on a wrong-hash artifact (fail).
Expected gain: the next shaper can order the implementation plus its review from exact edit points without surveying again. The next shaper reads the `## Recommendation` section.
No session can run LabVIEW: XML text only; native N0001/N0002 stay unverified.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md` exists with the headings `## Current behaviour`, `## Reuse`, `## Design`, `## Controls`, `## Recommendation`.
- [ ] Every claim about score.py or check_xml_keys.py cites a function name and line number you read in this session.
- [ ] `## Controls` lists at least three controls, each with input, expected outcome and reason.
- [ ] `## Design` names every live pin map entry (`benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` `protected_inputs_sha256`, `benchmark/preparation.json` path/sha256) that pins a file the design would change.
- [ ] No other repository file changed; `git status --porcelain` shows only the new file (no `__pycache__`).

## Verification
`python3 -B -I -c "t=open('benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md').read().splitlines(); H=['## Current behaviour','## Reuse','## Design','## Controls','## Recommendation']; m=[h for h in H if h not in t]; assert not m, m; print('citation-gap headings: OK')"`

## Context
- #831: the scorer never checks citations against the XML artifact (carried design limit). check_xml_keys.py checks key files, not submitted answers (#873, #878).
- `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` row "reader / probes / scorer integration" (PARTIAL) is the gap this addresses.
- Grep is one literal substring per call, no regex; if a Grep on an existing file is empty, Read in ranges.
- Always `python3 -B -I` if you run anything (#785). Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits.
- Role tools: a message "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session" is the CLI refusing a native tool; propose the same operation as a broker JSON action. It is not a block.

## Budget
- Read: `benchmark/scripts/score.py` (Grep `citation`, then `locator`, then `source`, then Read only those ranges), `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` (whole, it is small), `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` row lines, `docs/perpetua/evaluation.md` lines 60-80 only, `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json` one claim range only. Grep `library-specialty` in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` and `benchmark/preparation.json` for pin names.
- Do not read results, history, journal or whole JSON files. Short command output; report within 35 turns.
